items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: I had Black Benny on the bass drum. He's the bad man on the bass drum. Boy, he played more bass drum.

ctx.x: Well, that's good enough. There's so many Happys.
And Little Chinese. Black Benny was kind of rated up there among them, too.

items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: Black Benny was crazy about me and Louis.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, he and Black Benny were real good buddies. Black Benny looked after Louis, you see, when he was a kid. You can read that up in the book. No, I didn't.

Black Benny was crazy about me and Louis. Mm-hmm. And, uh, so that's probably the best I can tell you now about brass band. I can't remember it all. Oh, no. But Louis would go to 25 at night, and I would go to Astorias. Oh, yeah. See? He'd have to pass my place every night. He'd stop and stand up. I'd be upstairs. Mm-hmm. Wave, wave, wave, wave, and whatnot. And the next big parade, we'd get together on that.
